instruction: Go to the left and enter the doorway, turn to the right and stop in front of the table.

steps.thought: I see a doorway on the left side of the room past the massage table. I need to turn left and move toward that doorway first.
After turning left, I can see a doorway on the right side of the frame leading to another room. I need to align with it and head through, then turn right toward the table inside.

The doorway is to the left of the massage table, so I will turn left to aim at it and take one careful step toward it before re-observing. The table in front may be the final target, but I will first follow the instruction toward the doorway.
The doorway is ahead, slightly left, but the massage table blocks the direct path. I will veer left to go around the table and approach the doorway, then re-observe before entering.
I have already passed through the doorway and turned; the table now fills the view directly in front of me, well within 3 m. This matches 'stop in front of the table,' so I will stop here.
